title: My Anime soccer game
author: Remote-History-6458
selftext: The state of my game so far, I'm doing this solo, I never builded a game before, and I'm also doing this just on the side for me and some friends, so far it's been fun I hope to be able to get to a point in wich is solid and fun to play

comments.author: PairOfPixelsGS
comments.body: Nice! Do you intend to sell it or it's a personal project?

replies.author: Remote-History-6458
replies.body: I know I can't sell it with real names and clubs, so I'm looking at options, maybe like the very first pro evolution soccer where everything was a distorted version of the real names 😂 but for now still no sellable for sure too many small bugs
